description: [$1.00] Deposit $1.00 USDC once to mint an HMAC-signed Bearer session token (x402s_...) for zero-402 high-frequency API calls with atomic balance debits. Do not use for single paid calls or read-only checks (call any tool directly with x402/MPP). Every call charges `$1.00` USDC and mints a fresh `x402s_...` Bearer session (does not top up prior sessions); `ttl_minutes` sets expiry and `payer_address` binds ownership. Persists prepaid meter in SQLite (non-custodial); requires x402/MPP at 30-60 req/min.
